caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a slightly raised lid. The chest is rendered in shades of brown, with a darker brown used for the lid and lighter brown for the body and legs. The front of the chest is divided into three vertical panels, each adorned with carved decorative patterns featuring swirling, leaf-like and vine motifs. Above the three main panels is a horizontal frieze that also bears intricate, curling designs similar to those on the vertical panels. The sides of the chest are plainer, defined by simple rectangular framing. The drawing is outlined with fine black lines, and the background is a plain, off-white color with a faint border drawn around the chest.
title: Chest
